# `aitbc trade register-chain`

Register a new chain for inter-chain trading.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc trade register-chain [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | Chain ID to register |
| `--endpoint` | text | — | yes | Blockchain node RPC URL for the chain |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc trade register-chain --chain-id <chain_id> --endpoint <endpoint>
```
